tunisia-2024.notes: Source 5 is a Codeforces blog of the ACPC 2024 qualified teams (a different contest). Source 7 is the status page of Codeforces gym 105020, whose title names TCPC 2022, so it belongs to tunisia-2022. Source 8 is a private Codeforces group page without copy. The PC^2 boards (3, 4) give for the win (EPT) 9 solved/421 and Fama Haja 10/954 at the top, while the standings in source 6 give for the win 11/1182; the boards are stamped 5 Sep 2024 14:41 GMT. Sources 1 and 2 are single news posts of the host school's site; kept as web with medium confidence.

tunisia-2025.notes: Sources 1 and 4 are PC^2 boards stamped 5 Jul 2025 15:27 GMT; the leader has 8 solved there against 10 in the standings of source 6, so they are judged a snapshot before the end (frozen_scoreboard, medium); the pages themselves do not say frozen. Source 4 has nine teams that source 1 lacks (eight tagged ITA, plus Have f(Un) of INSAT). Source 2 is a single news post of the school's site, kept as web with medium confidence. Source 5 is a Codeforces blog of the ACPC 2025 qualified teams. Sources 3 and 7 have no copy.
